title: Tree rightmost traversal
summary: Recovered the read-only thiscall traversal at VA 0x423240: follow +8 right links while the child byte at +13 is zero, returning the last current node. Direct original disassembly and three tree-removal caller sites support the layout and use.
test_description: GCC i386 harness compares original_tree_rightmost with the member implementation over depths 0,1,2,7,31,127, all 255 nonzero sentinel byte values, and zero/nonzero starting flags; also tests a self-linked empty header. Checks expected pointer identity and byte-for-byte unchanged node array after each call. Installs test-owned FS backing and checks its head after each original call.
known_limits: Null or unreadable links and nonterminating zero-flag cycles are invalid original inputs and are not executed.
Node payload, owning container type, and exact original C++ names are unresolved; only the required prefix is modeled.
Original binary layout and ABI apply to 32-bit builds; native pointer layout is retained for wider Linux ports.
Behavioral recovery only; no matching-byte claim.
